title: How the Eras Tour Beat Elton John's Record (And Why It's Not the Same Race)
description:
Pollstar reported in December 2023 that Taylor Swift's Eras Tour had grossed more than $1 billion, passing the previous touring record of $939 million set by Elton John's Farewell Yellow Brick Road Tour. That total was amassed over five years because of pandemic delays, and earlier record tours by U2, Ed Sheeran and Elton John all included many more performances. Figures are as reported then; they are not updated here.
